runner_dissent: The biggest honesty obligation this run is NOT to declare a turn just because price finally entered the band. Band-entry is real, but the same period saw leverage go from a potential risk to a realized fact ($5.75B convertible + $3.5B facility), and the anchor was drawn on a balance sheet that was near-net-cash. Net of both, the margin of safety has NOT widened versus 09-05 - it has arguably narrowed.
